strings.en: I see...
With Amuro's group gone, your side must be struggling for strength too.
Umon's group did come here chasing the Vega Star Federation, but...
our numbers have been cut drastically.
We'd kept the Vega Star Federation from invading Earth until now,
but we let them slip through to the surface.
No, it couldn't be helped. There are plenty of enemies in space too...
Would it be all right if we kept Umon's group here for a while?
Yes. For now, they'll do more good with you.
Thank you.
The Vega Star Federation seems fixated on the Moon.
True, there are plenty of facilities that could serve as bases there,
like Anaheim and Von Braun, but...
What on earth is happening in the Earth Sphere?
Far too many incidents are piling up. What they have in common is...
that every invading army... is aiming for Earth,
and a mystery army... the ones who call themselves the Einst.
Those robots made of bone... and the plant-like robots?
And then there's our still-unidentified helper...
That's our only saving grace. Still no idea who it is?
No. Probably from another star system... maybe not even human.
Something about a sword wolf...
Ours is a ninja.
Listen, Domon...
with the Shining Gundam's Super Mode you've used until now,
you cannot defeat Master Asia or the Devil Gundam.
Super Mode activates when your anger reaches its peak.
That emotion becomes energy and unleashes maximum power.
The emotion energy system Uncle Mikamura developed...
But with the emotional energy of anger, you lose your composure,
and openings appear...
...Then what am I supposed to do...?
...Meikyo Shisui.
Meikyo... Shisui...?
A mind clear as still water, without a single cloud... That is Meikyo Shisui.
If you master the mind of Meikyo Shisui,
that will truly be the real Super Mode...
The real Super Mode...
Yes. And to draw it out...!
What!? Mom's alive!? Is that true, Dad!?
I was told Mom went missing right after I was born...!
Your mother couldn't possibly be dead... She's no ordinary human...
No ordinary human...? What do you mean by that?
I was surprised too when I heard it from Sharkin.
Akira, your mother... was one of the Mu people.
The Mu people... the mysterious power of the ancient Mu Empire.
...Why! How!?
The Mu people were supposed to have died out 12,000 years ago!
That's right. But before they died out, the scientifically advanced Mu
somehow sent your mother to our time. Likely via a kind of cryo-sleep.
Then she married me... and gave birth to you.
Then... inside me... there's Mu blood...!?
That's right, Akira.
That's why you can pilot Raideen, a legacy of the ancient Mu Empire.
...Then, Dad, the way Raideen reacts whenever the Einst appear...
could that be connected somehow!?
It's quite possible.
Akira, I'll return to the lab and push ahead with my Mutron research.
I may find something out.
Mutron... said to be Raideen's driving force...
Until then... you must fight together with everyone.
Sharkin of the Demon Empire has fallen, but Earth's still in danger.
Yes, Dad...!
...I have some urgent business. In the rift between sea and land.
Please give Master Asia my regards.
I'll be right back once my business is done...
Just in case, I'll leave a few guardians behind, so do not worry.
Farewell, then...
So here you are, Princess Romina.
What is it, Dr. Hazuki?
It's about the Elshank's fuel we discussed before.
You mean the Kirhasium?
Yes. We did manage to obtain it, but
we can't have it transported all the way here.
Kirhasium is a dangerous substance. That's only to be expected.
They say even a little jolt can make it blow up.
Having it brought all the way here is out of the question,
but they've agreed to bring it as far as the Space Science Laboratory.
Our fuel is still all right, isn't it, Gameran?
Yes, Princess. It'll last a while longer.
I see. Then until we have a chance to stop by the Space Science Lab,
I must ask you to wait a little while.
Understood, Dr. Hazuki.
Tell me, Schwarz! This real Super Mode you talk about...
Very well. ...Have at you, Domon!
Gundam Fiiight! Readyyy!
H-Hold on a second... I have no intention of fighting you here.
Gooo!
How can Schwarz move his Gundam so freely in such a cramped place?
With the mind of Meikyo Shisui, Domon!
Easy for you... to say!!
Domon, come at me for real! Otherwise, you'll lose your life!
Ngh...!
Take this, and this, and this, and this!
A-At this rate...
Hahahahaha, give up, Domon!
With a quiet heart... DIE!
(I-I'm done for...! I'll die... I'm going to die... W-What is this feeling?
Brother? Father, Mother? Master? Everything is fading away...
Anger, hatred, none of it matters... Only death before me... Rain!?)
I can see it...!?
Ohh!
W-What is this light...!? What on earth?
It is the mind of Meikyo Shisui...
Listen. A clear heart without rancor or guilt: that is Meikyo Shisui.
It can grant a person power beyond themselves...
That's my Super Mode... But why are you teaching me!?
That doesn't matter! Right now, focus on perfecting the technique!
Use that power to push back my Gundam...
Only then can you perfect your Super Mode and...
What is this...
The Death Army?
Just one step away from completing your training...
Domon! Leave this to me and get your Gundam moving!
Got it! Come!
SHIIINING GUNDAAAAAM!
Where's the epicenter?
The location is... the Guiana Highlands!
From that tremor just now, that was no ordinary earthquake.
What's wrong, Asuka?
...It must be that thing...
What thing? Quit stalling and tell us.
You mean... the Devil Gundam, I assume? Asuka?
Yes... This feeling...
The Devil Gundam!?
That's right. It matches the direction it fled in, too.
The Guiana Highlands aren't that far from Jaburo...
It might be a good place for the Devil Gundam to hide...
In that case, Kasshu and Rain are in danger...
Huh? What do you mean?
According to Mikamura, Kasshu and the others
are training in the Guiana Highlands.
If that thing shows up... the Shining Gundam alone doesn't stand a chance!
Still, knowing Domon Kasshu, he'd do it even if it's reckless.
Whoa, no doubt about it. Isn't that bad?
Then let's hurry and go help him!
The Gandor will now head for the Guiana Highlands.
Be ready to sortie the moment we arrive.
